summary: ACDC #170：FOCIL 不进 Glamsterdam，转为下一升级 CFI，soispoke 随后宣布 FOCIL 列为 SFI；EIP-8045 列为 CFI。DamianStraszak 提出带链上追溯匿名控制的屏蔽池，pememoni 说明 CREATE2 如何防止隐私系统泄露初始存款。VitalikButerin 呼吁加密通讯支持无需许可注册与元数据隐私。

items.title: ACDC #170
items.note: 21:00，据 Ethereal news #0：Fusaka 12 月 3 日 21:49 UTC 上线，主网升级与事故响应计划就绪；ePBS devnet 预计 12 月底或 1 月；EIP-8045 排除被罚没验证者出块列为 CFI；FOCIL、EIP-8071 与 EIP-8062 不进 Glamsterdam，FOCIL 转为下一升级 CFI；soispoke：FOCIL 已列为 SFI 21:47。
items.note_en: 21:00, per Ethereal news #0: Fusaka ships December 3 at 21:49 UTC with a mainnet upgrade and incident response plan; an ePBS devnet is due late December or January; EIP-8045, excluding slashed validators from proposing, is CFI; FOCIL, EIP-8071 and EIP-8062 are out of Glamsterdam, with FOCIL CFI for the next upgrade; soispoke: FOCIL is SFI, 21:47.

keywords_en: ACDC #170 moves FOCIL out of Glamsterdam and SFI for the next upgrade
shielded pools with onchain retroactive anonymity control
EIP-6404 moves to the EIP-7932 registry
Vitalik gives 128 ETH each to Session and SimpleX
summary_en: ACDC #170: FOCIL is out of Glamsterdam and CFI for the next upgrade, and soispoke then announced FOCIL is SFI; EIP-8045 is CFI. DamianStraszak proposed shielded pools with onchain retroactive anonymity control, and pememoni showed how CREATE2 stops privacy systems leaking initial deposits. VitalikButerin called for permissionless signup and metadata privacy in encrypted messaging.
